moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-elastic, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % on elastic.out(1, 0.3), 1000 ms: 2^(−10p)·sin((10p − 0.75)·2π/3) + 1, first peak 137 % at 13.5 % of the time, then shrinking swings. Site rule: playful; never for premium looks. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (1 s) · amplitude (1) · period (0.3).
